svg.title: lucasCore data blueprint: national datasets and the stages that read them
svg.text: The national datasets lucasCore reads, the stages that read them, what for, and the option that switches each one · version 1.0.0
read only under a non-default option

g.text: state PLOT, COND, TREE, DWM csvs + REFERENCE
Collection 1 · 30 m · one map a year
Model grid, land mask, primary, secondary and tertiary strata rasters
Set by: Build Options (cell size, strata sources); Study Area
Merchantable volume and live-tree carbon curves per forest class and ecodivision
Set by: Growth Curve Options (FIA Data, fit settings)
Stock-flow parameters and the dead organic matter decay calibration
Set by: Carbon Method; the Carbon Assumptions sheets
State class and stand age maps, annual NLCD on the grid, return intervals, soil targets
Set by: Build Options (Forest Type Map, Land Cover Resampling); Land Cover Crosswalks
Historical transition pathways, targets and annual spatial multipliers
Set by: defaults/transitions/sources.csv (where each transition group comes from)
Initial carbon stock maps by age and last disturbance
Projection transition targets, fire sizes and slope selectivity
Set by: Projection Options; Projection Transitions; Fire
Surfaces that place projected transitions, with adjacency and patch sizes
Set by: Projection Allocation; Suitability Options and Covariates; Rule Weights
Historical climate flow multipliers on growth and decomposition
Set by: Climate Options (forest and non-forest growth, decomposition)
Set by: Projection > Climate (LOCA2 scenario, model, replicate)

g.aria-label: Stage 12–14, Build, Run and Compare Figures
g.text: PNG figures of a Build, a run, and a run comparison
Set by: Run Figures; Compare Runs

svg.text: Wires run from a dataset to each stage that reads it, coloured by the stage. Vintages are those of the default paths in package.xml (Data Sources: a blank sheet uses them).
Stages 0 and 4 read no national data. Generated by docs/blueprint/build-data.R from package.xml (lucasCore 1.0.0), 2026-10-29.
